citations.narrative:
In the "Thunderdome" outdoor enclosure, which houses two black-handed spider monkeys and one black spider monkey,
there is an area of excessive rust. On one of the horizontal support poles within the enclosure, there is a section along the
top half where the metal has rusted through. This has created a large hole with rough, rusted edges that compromises the
structure of the pole and is in a place where the spider monkeys can access it.
Rust can compromise structural strength, present roughened or broken surfaces where it is possible for the nonhuman
primates to injure themselves, and prevent proper cleaning and sanitization of a surface. Any surfaces that come in
contact with the nonhuman primates must be free of excessive rust that prevents the required cleaning and sanitization,
or that affects the structural strength of the surface.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representatives.
Additional Inspectors:
David Mersereau, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICER n
